label: VERIFIED
extraction: Team Agent Orchestration skill for reliable team-based orchestration with work items, ownership, agent Kanban, branch isolation, control pane, merge gates. Agent contract: Owner, Scope (files, branch, tool surface, forbidden areas), State (backlog/ready/running/review/blocked/merged/archived), Evidence (tests, screenshots, logs, review notes, eval reports), Merge gate. Kanban columns with exit criteria: Backlog (acceptance criteria written), Ready (owner + branch/worktree assigned), Running (handoff artifact + changed files), Review (tests + diff review + risk check pass), Blocked (blocker owner + next action), Merged (PR merged), Archived (reason recorded). Flow: shape board, pick execution mode, assign boundaries, run agents (write evidence/handoff), review in sequence, merge deliberately (one integrator), extract reusable skill. Control pane: active items + Kanban state, owner/harness/branch/worktree/heartbeat, handoff artifacts/PRs, blockers by owner, merge readiness by gate. Failure modes: agent soup, invisible work, board theater, overlapping writes, no product artifact.
